title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot in Forms for US Government clouds
notes: claim 49: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing labels government-cloud licensing as mixed without evidence establishing that split. It also unnecessarily casts doubt on Microsoft's government-cloud data-boundary statement and tells administrators that user guidance is the only response to unwanted use, overlooking controls that block Forms itself.
